card.name: Words just before 'apart' in spacing
card.fires_on: Words in a phrase about doses or events being spaced out, right before 'apart' (such as 'approximately 12 hours apart' or 'one month apart'). It also fires on the lead-in to split doses.

modes.label: Dose spacing
modes.description: Dosing instructions where doses are given a set time apart, just before 'apart'.

modes.label: Split doses
modes.description: Total doses divided into several tablets or infusions that are given separately.

modes.label: Physical spacing
modes.description: General text about things placed or occurring far apart.
modes.example: If you plant seedlings<< far>> enough apart, the seedlings sprout
